violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: SEAWEED SALAD (44F) AND CREAM SAUCE (43F) WERE STORED IN TRUE 1-DOOR DISPLAY COOLER (#7) OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: OVERNIGHT OATS (39F) WAS PREPARED ON 12/2/2025. BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER (#1) FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level @EQUIPMENT@ is not observed. THERE IS NO AIR GAP UNDER EACH BASIN OF THE 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. PLEASE CREATE AN AIR GAP FOR EACH OF THE BASIN AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. HAND SINK AT COOK LINE WAS USED TO STORE A CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM REMOVED THE CONTAINER.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: THE HAND SINK AT BAR PREP AREA IS OUT OF ORDER.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PLEASE REPAIR THE HAND SINK WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: (1) HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WAS NOT SANITIZING. SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF DISHWASHER WAS 151F. (2) LOW-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WAS NOT SANITIZING. OBSERVED A SANITIZING RINSE CONCENTRATION OF LESS THAN 50PPM CHLORINE SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: TOMATO SOUP (38F) WAS PREPARED ON JUNE 4TH, 2025. BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STROED IN WALK-IN COOLER (#1) FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES IN KITCHEN AND BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PEST CONTROL SERVICE WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: A FOOD Employee observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. CFM PROMPTED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE TO PUT ON HAIR RESTRAINT.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM RELOCATED THE WET WIPING CLOTHES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER AND LOW-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER ARE NOT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE DISHWASHERS AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORTS TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked chicken wings, cooked beef held in walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

violations.title: Equipment Cooking Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment were observed soiled with an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris: interior of 4 drawer prep refrigerator has accumulation of food debris and dried liquid.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue and other debris to maintain a sanitary work environment and prevent pest attraction. PIC stated the equipment would be cleaned at the end of the breakfast period.
